pins.name: GND
pins.notes: Pin order varies between boards: match by the printed label.

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: 3.3 V or 5 V (on-board regulator on most boards)

pins.name: SCK
pins.notes: SPI clock. Some boards print SCL: still SPI, not I2C

pins.name: RES
pins.notes: Reset. Needed: the SSD1309 will not start without a reset pulse
